notes.title: The AI is ready!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33705937/8cb5674ab52f40511b1e3d0860fa50a015c2e47b.jpg

Dear Foosball Gladiators,

Today we are more than happy to release our Koliseum Soccer with AI bots.

Now, with the AI bots, you can start playing real matches. It’s finaly time to perform the unique features of our game, naming the dribble, the lob and the basic shoot you've been training, on the practice mode, these last weeks.  

Our AI bots have 5 levels of increasing difficulty:

 Beginner:  We all started... one day
 Regular:   It’s a good base
 Expert:  Sounds like you learned how to play
 Master:  Wow... you’re damn good !
 Shaolin:  Are you serious?


You can choose to play 1 vs 1 or 2 vs 2. So, give it a try and master it before changing levels.

BTW, we’ll be pleased to have your feedback about the levels of our AI bots, to adjust  them accordingly (contact@kynoa.com).

The next big feature is going to be multiplayer online. Stay tuned.

Kynoa Team

notes.title: The bonuses are ready, AI is coming...very soon!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33705937/52e208295f729b836518b29b20223394502a7192.png

Dear Foosball Gladiators,

Since our Koliseum Soccer VR is not a simple copy of the traditional table soccer game, we implemented different unique bonuses.  You certainly saw already some of them by watching our trailers.  

There are four different bonuses:

 The death ball (OMG you better have to play it because it will destroy your players anyway)
 The shield (You’ll get a shield that will save one goal for you)
 The multiball (You’ll play 3 balls at the same time)
 The bouncing ball (Extra rebonds for a couple of seconds)


How and when do they appear?  

The bonuses appear randomly, during the matches only (not on practice mode), by popping-up on the field. To activate them, you’ll just need to shoot them with the ball.

Beyond the obvious fun aspects, bonuses can significantly change the score of a match. Mastering their tactical dimension is a real advantage.

Kynoa Team

notes.title: About the Practice Mode
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33705937/df93ac3a766e48c21fce949d209039a9e10741ff.jpg

Dear all,

Since we started, our tutorial was explaining the few different tricks we implemented in our game.  Thanks to your feedback we decided to add a practice mode, so you can train these new tricks. So, here is a preview of the practice mode we released a couple of days ago .   

 Here are the 3 practice mode:
 the Shoot - 4 levels - from a single target to shoot at, to a moving target behind moving silhouettes.
 the Dribble - 4 levels - from a simple grab to a long dribble avoiding moving silhouettes to finnaly hit a moving target
 the Lobe - from a simple little lobe to a very long one (the goalkeeper must score by shooting above several rows of silhouettes)


These changes are live since a few days!

Enjoy, and thanks again for all your constructive feedback around the game!

Kynoa team
